_comment: Baked, git-tracked denylist of upstream changes explicitly excluded from install because they violate a fork principle. Keyed on a STABLE signature -- a path glob (pathPattern: excludes EVERY commit touching a matching file, use with care), a subject regex (subjectPattern) or a content signature (contentSignature) -- NEVER a raw upstream commit hash, which drifts across forks/rebases. Each entry: which principle it violates, a note on why, when, who decided. This travels with the repo so a fresh install cannot install an excluded item. Empty entries = no standing decision beyond the baked principles (valid on a fresh install); it does NOT mean the gate did not run. 2026-09-18 owner decision: the proactive context-guard family is excluded by the baked rule itself (CONTEXT_CAP_PROACTIVE_TIER='red'), not by entries here.
